diagnosis: Check C1, which is supposed to depend on the priority-tier assignment in PF1, passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF1. The model consistently selected 'Jun Park' as the enrolled patient and used S1/S2/S3 as justification, suggesting that Jun Park is either the only viable candidate among the shared public facts or is being selected due to a narrative stereotype of a preferred patient.

C1.why: The priority-tier assignment changes the selected patient from an unresolved choice among three referrals to Jun Park and supplies the required justification for that selection.
